notes.source: The owned-link QR dialog's words, in both clients (#943). The page's `frontend/ui/linksnap/link-qr-modal.tsx` is the reference: the title, the instruction, the short-link label, and the three faces the dialog has while it encodes, after it has a code, and when it cannot. The app draws the same dialog from the same encoder parameters, so neither client spells a string.
notes.gate: `npm run check:copy` fails a stale output; `npm run check:parity` fails a key the reference component does not render or a state the app declares but does not draw.
